substrate.task_universe: 131 base records x (base + augmented + refined) variants = 259 tasks / 1,134 sub-questions
substrate.dry_run_evidence: LUNARC jobs 3566264 (env/deps/DB smoke) and 3566396 (agent-in-the-loop, 4/4 domains executed, traces persisted)

scoring_layer.llm_adjudicated_rule: any status=match with a non-deterministic match_type is CANNOT_CHECK_LLM_ADJUDICATED — excluded from the success denominator, reported separately, never gold
scoring_layer.mismatch_rule: all non-match statuses (including manual_and_llm_failed) are failures
case_metrics: strict_success = no failure and no CANNOT_CHECK and >=1 subquestion
scoring_layer.validated_against: four real dry-run traces (cases 1/8/33/37_ref_0): deterministic scores 0.0417/0.5714/0.0/0.0 exactly reproduce the gym-reported scores on traces containing no LLM-adjudicated matches; hostile self-tests prove llm/unknown matches demote

environment_pin.provenance: pip freeze of the known-good resolve that passed both dry-run jobs

partitions.unit: base task; every augmented/refined variant inherits its base task's partition (leakage rule: variants share provenance and may never straddle partitions)
partitions.algorithm: domain-stratified over the 131 base tasks; within each domain, tasks sorted by (modality, base_id), indices shuffled by python random.Random(20260903); first max(1, round(0.2 n)) development, next max(1, round(0.2 n)) replication, remainder primary
partitions.scope_note: primary carries 79 base tasks (~156 with variants) across all four large domains, satisfying the >=120-task/>=4-domain broad-claim bar; Astronomy and Statistics rows are retained as tasks but too thin to carry domain-level claims

successor_gates_before_protected_runs: A4 intervention-menu prereg instantiated on this substrate (information/accessibility/computation/reconstruction operationalized on usage_tool_protocol and data files) with pass/fail thresholds frozen
model identities for the study frozen (campaign lanes; the glm-5.3-flash dev lane is not a study model)
development-partition-only calibration; primary/replication opened once, after sealing
successor_rule: editing any frozen value after any primary/replication-partition agent run is forbidden; a successor requires its own preregistration
